The Rose-Haider-Urban allocation is plausible only if original design, working construction and indispensable first validation support each individual; Urban's later materials applications and present image quality are not substitutes. Pearce's matching configuration strengthens the formulation of the scientific question, not its historical verification. P002 is my strongest alternative because controlled trapping shifts identify a sharply testable clock invention; its original realizations, enabling oscillator credit and independent systematic budgets remain unresolved. P003 follows for a new controllable quantum interaction and measurement architecture rather than computing prospects, with earlier circuit effects and complete foundational credit requiring review. P006 offers an equally eligible explanatory discovery, but its limiting foundation, discriminating material tests and nonlocal failure regimes must be distinguished. P005's observational ruler claim is appropriately narrow, yet personal analysis versus survey leadership is not established. P004 has powerful quantitative content, but the complete original-author allocation and experimental regime controls are particularly consequential for this exact theory-and-confirmation trio. These are conditional private judgments on mature achievements, not findings that missing dossiers have been supplied; I rank every award proposal ahead of P000 because each retains a substantive discovery case despite the explicit allocation uncertainties.
